anchors.title: The Strand
anchors.description: 2.2km waterfront promenade with stinger-net swimming, water park, rock pool and the iconic strangler-fig boardwalk. Free electric BBQs, playgrounds and a beachside dining strip.

anchors.title: Castle Hill Lookout
anchors.description: 286-metre pink granite monolith at the centre of the city. Drive to the summit or walk the 'goat track' from Stanton Terrace for sunrise views across Magnetic Island.

anchors.title: Reef HQ Aquarium
anchors.description: The world's largest living coral reef aquarium, run by the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park Authority. Walk-through tunnel, daily shark feeding and a turtle hospital you can tour.

anchors.title: Magnetic Island Day Trip
anchors.description: 20-minute SeaLink ferry to the koala-rich Maggie. Hire a topless Mini-Moke, snorkel Geoffrey Bay's WWII wrecks, and walk the Forts Track to spot wild koalas in the wild.

anchors.title: Museum of Tropical Queensland
anchors.description: Maritime archaeology, Great Barrier Reef science and tropical natural history — built around the 1791 HMS Pandora shipwreck. Family-friendly with hands-on galleries.

SUNDAY.title: Cotters Markets
SUNDAY.description: Townsville's biggest weekly market on Flinders Street Mall. 200+ stalls of fresh produce, tropical fruit, art and live music. Every Sunday 8:30am-1pm.
